what_it_is: Comprehensive fixation system from occiput to pelvis. Open, MIS (MAS), and hybrid approaches in single platform. Variants: Reline MAS (minimally invasive), Reline Open, Reline 3D (deformity with VBD derotation), Reline Fenestrated (cement for tumors), Reline Traction (optimized insertional torque), Reline ASF (revision/extension), Reline Cervical.
indications: Posterior spinal fixation occiput to pelvis. Degenerative, deformity, tumor, trauma, revision.
